standard_prerequisites.use: Definition of perfect closed immersion (locally cut out by Koszul-regular sequences, chapter definition section); More on Algebra, lemma perfect-ring-map (finite projective resolution from a perfect ring map); Cohomology, section perfect (the object-level definition being verified).

core_obligations: Work on affine opens where the ideal is presented.
Convert the perfect immersion hypothesis into a finite projective resolution.
Recognize the local finite locally free complex as the definition of a perfect object.

proof_roadmap.step: Finite projective resolution plus definitional recognition.

difficulty_reason: For a perfect closed immersion i : Z -> X of schemes, the lemma states i_* O_Z is a perfect O_X-module, i.e. a perfect object of D(O_X). The retained proof is written as an affine-local verification: on U = Spec(A) the preimage is Spec(A/I) and the hypothesis that I is generated by a Koszul-regular sequence (the definition of perfect closed immersion) gives, via More on Algebra, lemma perfect-ring-map, a finite resolution of A/I by finite projective A-modules; restricting i_* O_Z to U is represented by the corresponding finite complex of finite locally free modules, which is exactly the definition of a perfect object recalled through the Cohomology section on perfect complexes. Retained author proof at lines 17960-17970.

dedup.scope: Perfectness of the direct image structure sheaf along perfect closed immersions.
